## Consulting

![](assets/Logos/kaido-lockup-on-light.svg){.light-content .kaido-lockup fig-alt="Kaido Analytics"}
![](assets/Logos/kaido-lockup-on-dark.svg){.dark-content .kaido-lockup fig-alt="Kaido Analytics"}

Through Kaido Analytics LLC, I take on statistical analysis and reporting work for public safety agencies and other clients.

::: {.callout-important title="Availability"}
I'm currently accepting consulting work on a case-by-case basis only.
:::

The kind of work I do:

- **Reproducible reports.** Statistical analyses and reports built in R and Quarto, including recurring reports that are rebuilt each year from new data. For example, I have built and maintained an annual benchmarking report for a client for two consecutive years.
- **Modeling.** Regression, Poisson-based demand and forecasting models, simulation, Markov chain models, optimization and machine learning.
- **End to end.** From cleaning complex, imperfect data through to client-facing reports.

If you have a project in mind, email me with a short description of the question, the data and the timeline.
